reporter.headline: Simulated Planet Nine at V 15.0: recovered in the stack
reporter.dossier_md:
This is a synthetic planet from the Caltech reference population, injected into real SPHEREx frames along its true parallax track at 291 AU. It is invisible in any single frame (best single-frame SNR 44.7) and reaches SNR 30.7 when the frames are shifted along the correct trial motion and stacked.

The search recovered it with the right distance bin, which is the point of the injection test: it measures how deep the search reaches. 

Nothing about this object is real. It exists to calibrate the search and to train the classifier and the crowd.

sources: NASA SPHEREx DR1 Level 2 spectral images via IRSA (irsa.ipac.caltech.edu)
